This skill doesn't apply here — and forcing it would actively harm your product.

**Why:** Intelligent Clay productizes *services* (consulting, agency work, coaching, done-for-you delivery). Your offering is already SaaS. SaaS is born modular: features, seats, usage limits, and tiers are the atoms. You don't need to decompose human-delivered work into configurable units, because there's no human-delivered work in the loop.

**What you likely actually want, depending on the underlying question:**

- **Packaging / tier redesign** (which features go in Free vs. Pro vs. Enterprise, what drives upgrades) → SaaS pricing & packaging frameworks: Patrick Campbell / ProfitWell, Kyle Poyar's work, or the "value metric" lens (per-seat vs. per-project vs. per-usage).
- **Add-ons / modules on top of Pro** (e.g., Advanced Reporting, SSO, Automations as paid modules) → feature-bundling and willingness-to-pay analysis, not service decomposition.
- **Enterprise productization** (turning custom Enterprise quotes into a repeatable SKU ladder) → this is closer to my territory but still SaaS-side; the right tool is a published Enterprise tier with named modules (SSO, audit logs, dedicated CSM, SLA), not atomic decomposition.
- **Self-serve → sales-assisted → enterprise motion design** → PLG/sales-led hybrid frameworks (Wes Bush, OpenView).
- **Roadmap / what to build next** → product discovery (Teresa Torres, continuous discovery).

**One case where I *could* help:** if you also sell **services around the SaaS** — onboarding packages, implementation, training, customer success retainers, custom integration work — those are clay. I can productize the services layer while leaving the software pricing alone.

Want to redirect toward any of these? If you have an implementation/onboarding/services arm bolted onto the SaaS, name it and I'll run the blueprint on that piece.

This skill doesn't apply here. Handmade leather wallets are a physical product — they're already "modular" in the SKU/bundle/variant sense (color, leather type, monogramming, card slots), which is a different problem than productizing a service.

What Intelligent Clay does is take *service* offerings (consulting, coaching, agency work, done-for-you delivery) — where the work is custom and time-bound — and turn them into configurable tiered packages. There's no service to decompose in your case; there's a finished good you sell.

**What you probably want instead:**

- **Product variants / SKU architecture** — color, leather (full-grain, bridle, exotic), thread color, hardware, card-slot count
- **Bundle logic** — wallet + cardholder + keychain at a bundle discount
- **Customization tiers** — stock / monogrammed / made-to-order with hide selection / fully bespoke commission
- **Pricing ladder** by leather grade and customization depth

The *only* part of your business this skill could help with is if you offered a **service alongside the product** — e.g., "bespoke commission consultations," "leather care subscriptions with quarterly reconditioning," "corporate gifting programs with custom branding and account management," or "wallet repair/restoration service." Those are services and could be productized into tiers.

If any of those apply, tell me which one and I'll run the full blueprint on it. Otherwise, you'd be better served by an e-commerce merchandising or pricing-strategy resource.

## Part 2 — Configuration Architecture

| Dimension | What it controls | Levels | Dependencies |
|---|---|---|---|
| Depth | How much human strategist augments the skill | Skill-only / Async-reviewed / Live-co-piloted / Done-for-you | Done-for-you blocks Skill-only support tier |
| Breadth | Vertical/reference-pack coverage | Core only / +1 vertical pack / All vertical packs / Custom vertical authored | Custom vertical requires Live-co-piloted Depth or higher |
| Pace | Engagement cadence | One-shot / Quarterly re-blueprints / Continuous (monthly) | Continuous requires async-review or higher |
| Format | Output rendering | Markdown only / +Configurator export / +White-label rendering | White-label requires licensed tier |
| Support | Access + response | Community / Async 48hr / Async 24hr + office hours / 1:1 SLA | 1:1 SLA only on top tier |
| Seats / Reseller | Who can run the skill, on whose behalf | Solo / Team (≤5) / Agency (unlimited internal) / Reseller (client-facing) | Reseller requires White-label Format + Agency seats |
| **Benchmark Data** *(domain-specific)* | Access to pricing-anchor DB | None / Read-only / Read+contribute / Full API | Full API requires Team+ |
| **Memory Sophistication** *(domain-specific)* | Cross-run learning | Stateless / claude-mem local / Shared team memory / Cross-org anonymized insights | Shared team requires Team seats; cross-org opt-in only |
| **Vertical Authoring** *(domain-specific)* | Right to author + distribute new reference packs | Read-only / Author for self / Author + contribute upstream / Author + monetize | Monetize requires Reseller |

**Invalid combinations the configurator must block:**
- Reseller seats without White-label format
- Continuous pace without at least Async 48hr support
- 1:1 SLA support on Solo seats (mismatched economics)
- Custom vertical authoring without Live-co-piloted Depth
- Cross-org memory without explicit opt-in flag
- Done-for-you Depth combined with Stateless memory (defeats the purpose)
- Monetize-authoring rights without Reseller tier

## Part 3 — Three Tiers + Build-Your-Own

The MIT core stays free forever. Paid tiers sit *above* it.

### Free — Open Source Core
- **Configuration:** Skill-only Depth · Core breadth · One-shot pace · Markdown format · Community support · Solo seat · No benchmark data · Stateless or local claude-mem · Read-only authoring
- **Positioning:** For the practitioner who wants to productize their own service once. Self-serve, MIT, no strings.
- **Pricing logic:** $0. Acquisition layer; the funnel.

### Lite — Practitioner *(+$A, one-time or low annual)*
- **Configuration:** Async-reviewed Depth (48hr) · Core + 1 vertical pack · One-shot or quarterly pace · Markdown + configurator export · Async 48hr support · Solo seat · Read-only benchmark DB · claude-mem local
- **Positioning:** For the solo consultant/coach who wants their *own* service productized, with a human sanity-check and exportable configurator output.
- **Pricing logic:** Anchored against the cost of one botched packaging attempt — a single mispriced tier easily costs more than this. Priced as a single-engagement upgrade, not a subscription.

### Core — Studio *(+$B, annual)* **← flagship**
- **Configuration:** Live-co-piloted Depth · All vertical packs · Quarterly pace · All formats incl. white-label · Async 24hr + office hours · Team (≤5) seats · Read+contribute benchmark DB · Shared team memory · Author-for-self
- **Positioning:** For the boutique agency or coaching studio that productizes *its own* offerings and wants live strategist co-pilot + shared team memory across engagements.
- **Pricing logic:** Anchored against ~one month of a fractional packaging consultant. Flagship — must remain the obvious choice for any team running this >2x/year.

### Premium — Agency / Reseller *(+$C, annual + per-engagement)*
- **Configuration:** Done-for-you Depth available · All packs + custom vertical authoring · Continuous pace · Full white-label · 1:1 SLA · Agency or Reseller seats · Full benchmark API · Cross-org anonymized memory (opt-in) · Monetize-authoring rights
- **Positioning:** For the agency that productizes *client* services as a billable offering, or the reseller embedding Intelligent Clay into their own platform.
- **Pricing logic:** Anchored against the revenue from a single reseller engagement — the tier pays for itself on the first client. Priced as a license, not a tool.

### Build-Your-Own Framework

- **Base:** Free core + Lite ($A) entry
- **Per-dimension upgrades:**
  - Depth: Async-reviewed (+x) · Live co-pilot (+y) · Done-for-you (+z, per engagement)
  - Breadth: per vertical pack (+v each) · custom vertical authoring (+w)
  - Pace: quarterly (+q) · continuous (+q×3)
  - Format: configurator export (+f) · white-label (+F)
  - Support: 48hr (+s) · 24hr+OH (+S) · 1:1 SLA (+SS)
  - Seats: Team (+t) · Agency (+T) · Reseller (+R)
  - Benchmark DB: read+contribute (+b) · full API (+B)
  - Memory: shared team (+m) · cross-org (+M, opt-in only)
- **Floor:** Lite — must include at least async review + 1 vertical pack to justify leaving Free
- **Ceiling:** any config exceeding Agency seats OR requesting Done-for-you OR Reseller rights auto-routes to Premium (custom-quoted)
- **Configurator-enforced dependencies:** all blocks from Part 2's invalid-combos list

**Flagship-protection rule:** BYO-summing to reach the Studio (Core) configuration must price ≥ ~1.3× Studio's flat annual. Specifically: Live co-pilot + all vertical packs + 24hr support + Team seats + shared memory, summed à la carte, must visibly exceed $B. Same constraint for Premium vs. its à la carte equivalent — Done-for-you + Reseller rights + full API must sum above $C, so the bundled tier is always the rational buy for anyone needing >2 of those dimensions.
